# 2011 Elections

There were 3 elections held in Jersey in 2011.

- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2011#e16)**

  4 seats · 13 candidates · 45.6% turnout
- **[Connétables General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2011#e14)**

  12 seats (8 uncontested) · 16 candidates · 46.1% turnout
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2011#e15)**

  29 seats (3 uncontested) · 64 candidates · 45.6% average turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2011 Senators Election
